title: Understand the loop
summary: Notice the stages that can keep a habit going.

sequence.title: A sequence to observe
sequence.paragraph1: A habit can sometimes be described as: situation → emotion → impulse → behavior → immediate effect or relief → consequences.
sequence.paragraph2: This is a practical observation model, not a sequence proven to apply to everyone. Some stages may happen very quickly or be difficult to notice.

action.title: Find a point of action
action.paragraph1: You do not need to control the entire loop. Changing location, waiting a few minutes, or choosing another action can create space.
action.paragraph2: Observing the situation and emotion can help you choose a realistic point of action.

observe.title: Observe without diagnosing
observe.paragraph1: StopCorn notes are personal markers, not a diagnosis.
observe.paragraph2: The aim is to make recurring sequences more visible so you can adjust your plan.

reflectionPrompt: Which part of the loop seems easiest to change this week?
